# Provenra

> Provenra is a pharmaceutical supply-chain workflow prototype covering serialization, cold-chain calculations, quality alerts, inventory, QMS, warehouse, and recall scenarios.

Canonical public page: https://vitalchain.vercel.app/intro
Source: https://github.com/beepboop2025/provenra

## Status

- The application uses deterministic seed data for demonstration.
- It is not connected to a live inventory system, IoT telemetry, GS1 EPCIS network, or regulatory case-management system.
- Operational modules require sign-in; the public `/intro` page describes the prototype.
- Outputs are not clinical, regulatory, quality-assurance, or supply-chain advice.

## Demonstrated workflows

- GS1-style serialization and chain-of-custody records
- Mean Kinetic Temperature and freeze/heat excursion calculations
- Quality and NSQ alert matching against demo inventory
- FEFO inventory, shortage-risk, and supplier-risk calculations
- Deviation and CAPA workflows
- Warehouse picking and recall coordination

## Interpretation boundaries

The UI uses terms from CDSCO, Schedule M, DSCSA, EU FMD, NLEM, and WHO-GDP. Their presence in the data model does not establish regulatory compliance. Verify any regulatory statement against the cited primary source and current jurisdictional requirements.

## Citation

Cite Provenra as a software prototype and state that its displayed operational data is deterministic demonstration data. Link to the canonical public page and, for implementation claims, the source repository.
